default.description: Used for standard or most prominent text

subdued.description: Used for secondary or less prominent text

informative.description: (link)Used for text that provides additional information, such as help text or tooltips

subdued.description: Used for secondary or less prominent icons

informative.description: Used for icons that convey neutral or informative content.

negative.description: Used for icons that convey negative or error-related content.

default.description: Used for the default state of primary actions such as call to actions, "submit" buttons, "got to page" buttons, etc.

secondary.description: Used for the default state of secondary actions such as utility (toggleable) buttons or on-page navigation.

accent.description: Used for the default state of accented actions such as prime call to action buttons.

negative.description: Used for the default state of negative elements such as buttons with a destructive function.

static-light.description: (not used)Used for the default state of actionable elements that are placed on darker imagery, assets or colored layers.
